android.desc: PDF Reader - Viewer & Editor is an easy-to-use document reader and PDF tool that helps you read, view, edit and manage documents directly on your Android device. Open PDF, Word, Excel and PowerPoint files in one place. Whether you need to read a PDF, edit a document, manage office files or use PDF tools, the app makes everyday document work simple and convenient. 📄 PDF Reader & Viewer Open and read PDF files quickly with a clean and comfortable PDF viewing experience. Easily access your important documents, reports, invoices, notes, forms and other PDF files. ✏️ Edit PDF Documents Make changes to your PDF documents with useful editing tools. Edit and manage PDFs without needing multiple apps for everyday document tasks. 📁 All Document Reader Access different document formats from one app: • PDF files • Word documents – DOC & DOCX • Excel spreadsheets – XLS & XLSX • PowerPoint presentations – PPT & PPTX Keep your office and personal documents conveniently accessible in one place. 🔗 Merge PDF Files Combine multiple PDF documents into a single PDF. Select your files, arrange them and create one organized document in seconds. ✂️ Split PDF Pages Split large PDF documents and extract the pages you need. Create a separate PDF from selected pages without keeping the entire document. 🔒 Protect PDF with Password Add password protection to important PDF files and keep private documents more secure. 🛠️ Useful PDF Tools Get essential PDF utilities in one app. Read, edit, merge, split and manage PDF documents with a simple interface designed for everyday use. ⭐ Easy Document Management Quickly find and organize your PDF and office documents. Access recent files, favorites and different document types without searching through multiple folders. Why use PDF Reader - Viewer & Editor? • Fast PDF Reader and PDF Viewer • PDF editing tools • Word, Excel and PPT reader • All document reader • Merge multiple PDF files • Split and extract PDF pages • Password-protect PDF documents • Easy file management • Clean and simple interface • Useful for work, study and everyday documents From reading a simple PDF to managing office documents and using essential PDF tools, PDF Reader - Viewer & Editor gives you the features you need in one convenient document app.
